sections.title: Machine Learning Applications for San Francisco Organizations
sections.description: Production ML solutions for SF's leading industries.

blocks.heading: FinTech Payment and Risk ML
paragraphs: For Stripe (SF HQ), Square/Block (SF HQ), Brex (SF HQ), and Bay Area FinTech:

Real-time payment fraud ML: Sub-100ms transaction risk scoring at billions-of-transactions-per-year throughput — using merchant network features, buyer behavioral patterns, device fingerprinting, and graph-based fraud signals at the scale and latency that Stripe's payment infrastructure requires.

Alternative credit underwriting: ML for Brex's corporate credit and Affirm's BNPL underwriting — incorporating business banking data, corporate financial signals, and purchase behavior features that traditional credit scores don't capture, with FCRA adverse action codes and ECOA disparate impact testing.

Subscription churn prediction: ML for SaaS and subscription FinTech products — incorporating product usage signals, support interaction patterns, and payment behavior to predict cancellation risk 30–90 days in advance.
Cost: $60,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | CCPA, FCRA, ECOA

blocks.heading: Biotech and Life Sciences Drug Discovery ML
paragraphs: For Genentech (South San Francisco HQ), Gilead Sciences (Foster City), Vir Biotechnology, and the Bay Area biotech cluster:

Molecular property prediction: Graph neural networks and transformer-based ML predicting ADMET properties, target binding affinity, and metabolic stability from molecular structure — enabling Bay Area biotech companies to prioritize drug candidates earlier in the discovery process.

Genomics and multi-omics integration: ML integrating whole genome sequencing, RNA-seq, proteomics, and clinical outcome data for Genentech's and Gilead's precision medicine programs — identifying molecular subtypes and biomarkers that predict treatment response.

Clinical biomarker discovery: ML for biomarker identification in Phase II and Phase III trial data — incorporating genomic, imaging, and clinical features to identify responder and non-responder molecular signatures.
Cost: $65,000–$175,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | FDA/ICH biostatistics, CCPA

blocks.heading: Enterprise SaaS Product ML
paragraphs: For Salesforce (SF HQ), Slack (SF HQ, Salesforce subsidiary), Dropbox (SF HQ), and SF's SaaS community:

AI product feature development: Churn prediction, user engagement forecasting, product recommendation, and intelligent feature surfacing for Salesforce's Einstein AI platform and the broader SF enterprise SaaS ecosystem.

B2B sales analytics: Lead scoring, opportunity win probability, and deal velocity prediction for Salesforce's Sales Cloud customers — incorporating Salesforce's unique position as the source of truth for enterprise sales data.
Customer success ML: Early warning systems for customer health deterioration and expansion opportunity identification for SF's large CSM-focused SaaS community.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Climate Technology ML
paragraphs: For Breakthrough Energy Ventures portfolio companies, C3.ai (Redwood City, adjacent SF), and Bay Area's world-leading climate tech community:

Carbon accounting ML: AI for corporate carbon footprint measurement, Scope 1/2/3 emissions quantification, and supply chain carbon analytics for the climate tech companies building the infrastructure for corporate decarbonization.

Renewable energy optimization: ML for solar, wind, and battery storage operations optimization — generation forecasting, grid dispatch optimization, and storage charge/discharge ML for California's advanced energy market.
Climate risk analytics: ML for physical and transition climate risk assessment in real estate, infrastructure, and supply chain contexts.
Cost: $50,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

sections.title: San Francisco ML Standards
sections.description: CCPA compliance, fairness evaluation, and model cards for SF's demanding ML market.

blocks.heading: CCPA compliance for all consumer ML
paragraphs: California's consumer privacy law makes CCPA compliance mandatory for any ML using California consumer data. ClickMasters designs SF consumer ML with CCPA data minimization, opt-out from automated profiling, and consumer rights as baseline requirements.

blocks.heading: Fairness and bias evaluation
paragraphs: SF's progressive technical culture expects explicit fairness evaluation for ML affecting people — demographic parity, equalized odds, and calibration assessments are standard deliverables for ClickMasters' SF consumer-facing ML.

blocks.heading: Model cards and transparency
paragraphs: SF's ML community has pioneered model cards as a transparency standard — ClickMasters delivers model cards for all SF ML projects documenting intended use, performance characteristics, and known limitations.
